violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §746.4811(c))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - on Sides
violation_type.typical_finding: Bucket swings in the toddler playground were found not having the 6 feet of use zone on the side of the adjacent swing and the fence.   *Swing was removed immediately.

finding_variants.text: Bucket swings in the toddler playground were found not having the 6 feet of use zone on the side of the adjacent swing and the fence.   *Swing was removed immediately.
The use zone on the sides of the bucket swings does not extend at least six feet. An additional 3 1/12 feet is required on both sides of the swing set.
The use zone for the bucket swings was 30.5 inches from the fence.
